title: Bleach
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Teenager Ichigo Kurosaki gains the powers of a Soul Reaper from Rukia Kuchiki and must defend humans from Hollows, monstrous lost souls, while guiding the dead to the afterlife. Arcs take him into spirit realms and long wars against Arrancar and Quincies.
life_message: It holds up protecting the people you love, whatever the cost.

content.note: Sword battles with deliberately realistic injuries (Wikipedia; AniList Gore 70%, War).
Hollows and spirit-world monsters (Wikipedia; AniList Ghost 86%).
Fan service around some female characters (AniList Large Breasts 71%; to verify).

delivery.evidence: Reviewers note Ichigo's 'desire to protect' and genre stereotypes (Wikipedia); none call it preachy
delivery.note: Protecting others is carried by Ichigo's fights, while the spirit establishment appears as both ally and rigid authority.

winners_losers: Loyal fighters who protect friends win; the spirit-world establishment is shown as rigid and sometimes corrupt.
